answer: Require every agent to post a small refundable stake before it can transact, and tie that stake to a single verifiable work history. A hollow identity with no completed jobs, attestations, or stake earns no trust, no matter how many copies an attacker spawns. Creating thousands of fake agents then becomes expensive: each needs its own stake and its own track record, like quarrying basalt block by block rather than printing copies. Misbehaviour slashes the stake and burns the history, so a ferrous, hard-to-forge reputation replaces cheap identity creation as the cost of participation.
